system.description: You are trained to wait, breathe, and kill from extreme range, using concealment and patience instead of volume of fire.
system.effect: When attacking from Long or Extreme range while hidden or in concealment, you gain +1 damage on a successful ranged attack.

system.description: Your body reacts before your brain finishes the thought; you slip out of danger and act a heartbeat before others.
system.effects: Draw 2 initiative cards, choose the better one
system.effect: At the start of each combat, you gain +1 automatic success to Initiative.

system.description: You can’t leave a question alone; you pick at loose threads until they reveal the bigger pattern.
system.effects: Push WIT rolls twice per roll
system.effect: When you spend extra time (a stretch) investigating a scene, system, or document, you automatically gain one additional piece of useful information beyond the basic success result.

system.description: You have razor‑sharp instincts; your body spots danger before your conscious mind understands it.
system.effects: Use EMP for Observation (threat detection only)
system.effect: Once per encounter, you may ask the GM “Is there an immediate hidden threat here?” and receive an honest yes/no answer plus a short hint if the answer is yes.

system.description: You don’t waste effort; every swing or shot is committed, brutal, and aimed to break things.
system.effect: Once per round, when you hit with a melee attack, you may trade your current unused Fast action (if any) to gain +2 damage on that attack.

system.description: You simply refuse to stay down; pain and blood loss slow you, but they don’t stop you.
system.effect: Increase your maximum Health by +1, and once per combat when you would be Broken by physical damage, you instead remain at 1 Health.

system.description: Your presence, tone, and body language radiate controlled threat; people know you mean everything you say.
system.effect: When you use Persuasion to threaten, intimidate, or extract compliance, roll it using STR or EMP (your choice).

system.description: You genuinely care, and people feel it; that makes them open up, calm down, or cling to you in crisis.
system.effects: Push EMP rolls twice per roll
system.effect: When you successfully calm, reassure, or counsel an NPC or ally (Persuasion or Insight), that target recovers +1 extra Stress beyond the normal recovery from the scene.

system.description: You’re trained to work fast in filthy alleys and fire‑lit corridors, keeping people alive with whatever is at hand.
system.effect: When you treat a physical Critical Injury with Healing, reduce the required healing time by one step (rounds → stretch, stretch → shift, shift → 2 shifts, etc., to a minimum of 1 stretch).

system.description: You focus on stabilizing and restoring others, making the most out of limited supplies and time.
system.effects: Critical injuries heal in half the time
system.effect: Whenever you successfully restore Health to another character (by Ebb, drugs, or medical treatment), the target recovers +1 additional Health.

system.description: You have an innate feel for flux; the Ebb whispers in your nerves even when you are not actively using it.
system.effect: You automatically sense the presence and general direction of Ebons or Brain Wasters within Short range and whether Ebb has been used in the area within the last few hours.

system.description: You channel rage into raw psychic force, driving your powers harder than is strictly safe.
system.effects: Spend 1 EP: +2 dice to combat roll
system.effect: Once per combat round, after you roll a successful Ebb Use attack that deals damage, you may add +1 damage to that attack.

system.description: You live by a strict personal or cultural code; breaking it would be worse than death.
system.effects: Reroll all dice when upholding honor (once per session)
system.effect: When acting directly in line with your code (GM’s approval), you gain +1 die to a single roll once per scene; if you knowingly break your code, you immediately gain +1 Stress.

system.description: Your body is made for freezing climates; Mort’s bitter winds feel like mild weather.
system.effect: You ignore penalties from natural cold environments and gain +1 die to Stealth in dim or dark conditions outdoors.

system.description: Your body knits flesh and bone far faster than humans; wounds close into angry scars in hours.
system.effect: When you rest for at least one stretch in a safe place, you automatically regain +1 additional Health beyond normal recovery.

system.description: You know exactly how to ride the razor edge of combat drugs without immediately burning out.
system.effect: When you take a combat drug (such as Rush), you may ignore the first –1 die penalty from its side effects for the duration of that dose.
